title: Forbidden Moonlit Wasteland
description: A surreal night desert landscape features a massive glowing full moon dominating a turbulent cloudy sky. Rusty mechanical debris, a glowing subterranean bunker, sparse desert plants, and a weathered sign with a crossed-out rocket are scattered across the sandy terrain with towering red rock mesas in the background.
prompt: Surreal night desert landscape with a giant luminous full moon breaking through dramatic swirling clouds. Red rock mesas stand in the distance under a dark purple and blue sky. In the foreground, scattered rusty mechanical wreckage, an illuminated half-buried bunker with glowing circular lights, sparse desert shrubs, and a weathered warning sign on a wooden post showing a crossed-out rocket symbol. Cinematic lighting, rich textured brushwork, moody and desolate atmosphere.
